# NESO Now

> Three live streams on YouTube read the latest government data on jobs, housing and construction, new federal
> rules, open federal funding and public bids around the clock, with a source for every line.

NESO Now is published by NESO HQ LLC (https://nesohq.com/). Site: https://now.nesohq.com/ · Streams:
https://www.youtube.com/@nesonow/streams

## What is on it

- **Today's figures:** official government figures on jobs, construction, building permits and main-street
  business, each with its source.
- **Federal rules:** new federal rules and notices as they publish.
- **Funding and bids:** open federal funding and public bids.
- **State by state:** https://now.nesohq.com/map/
- **The daily archive:** one page per day, for example https://now.nesohq.com/2026-11-20/

The voices on the streams are computer-generated. Figures come from the agencies that publish them; the agency's
own release governs.

Questions: hello@nesohq.com.

- [Story by Story](https://now.nesohq.com/story-by-story/): a NESO Now video series on how mixed-use developments get built, one project per episode, with sources and dates for every figure.
